name: Riding training
how: Apprentice Riding is learned at level 40 for 100g from your race's riding trainer and includes one basic racial mount (+60%). Journeyman Riding is learned at level 60 for 1,000g and allows swift mounts (+100%). Honored with your home faction gives 10% off training and racial mounts; the Bartering Legacy talent gives up to a further 10% off mounts (not training). Other races' mounts need Exalted with that race.
where: Your race's riding trainer (e.g. Randal Hunter, Elwynn Forest; Kildar, Orgrimmar; Genn Fairweather, Zephras Isle)
